scope: Bindings-managed owned WebGPU API reference accounting plus unchanged Android lifecycle evidence and comparative memory observations

baselineMemory.meaning: Native Heap PSS is the first Native Heap table column, not the differently defined App Summary value; no memory threshold determines ownership PASS

javascriptExceptions.policy: The unchanged demo expects no uncaught V8 callback exceptions, including diagnostic runs

nativeOwnership.scope: Only bindings-managed owned WGPU API result references; borrowed context/device/queue/adapter and internal native helpers are excluded
nativeOwnership.canvasViewPeakInterpretation: Multiple views of one current texture are legal; every sampled completed-frame boundary must release all owned Canvas views

coverage.meaning: Coverage allowance for five-second native snapshot sampling, not an application performance target; pause/lock intervals outside the continuous stage are excluded
